0022600218.text: The Cavaliers (5-6, 2nd in the Central and 7th in the East) visit the Knicks (5-4, on a three-game winning streak and 5th in the East) for Cleveland's 12th game of the season, after losing two straight and going 1-4 on the road. Jaylon Tyson is out with an ankle sprain, and Sam Merrill is day-to-day with an elbow injury and is a game-time decision. Cleveland trails 0-1 in the 2026-27 season series after losing 109-97 in Cleveland on November 7, and it lost 1-2 to New York in 2025-26 and 0-4 in the 2025-26 playoffs.
